steps.content: You've regained consciousness, but you don't recognize the scene before you at all.

Colossal rusty towers stand in a row before you, chopping up the sky. The iron steel forest looks like it'll collapse down on you any second. The sharp noise of metal breaking sounds like a person's growl.
Right, the Black Ring has already broken out. You couldn't stop it, and your own consciousness has fallen into a bottomless abyss.
Is this the world inside the Ring, or the afterworld? Are you alone?
The two of them are indeed standing behind you, but their faces are blurred and they remain silent. You try, but you can't even talk to them using the shackles. You can't do anything but wait.
Soon, a figure appears in the mist.
Zoya's portrait fades in
You want to move forward, but your legs won't move, as if your consciousness is floating outside your body. Zoya is also just standing, much like those still iron towers.
Gradually, you hear voices coming near from afar, but they also sound like they're coming directly from the depths of your consciousness.

steps.speaker: Faraway Voice
steps.content: The Legion has won again... The three gangs got crushed even though they'd teamed up. Carnivore had it the worst, they're doomed this time... Karma, hahaha, karma...

steps.speaker: Faraway Voice
steps.content: So what? It's just a dogfight among gangs. That rotten Legion must be even worse...

steps.speaker: Faraway Voice
steps.content: Their boss is a monster...
Slowly, a phantom-like figure steps out from the mist and walks toward Zoya.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Boss, we've barged into the police station, but we couldn't save Ayek and the others... They were lynched this morning.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: The sheriff who did this took Yagyu's money and blamed the dozens of deaths in the south warehouse last month on us... all on us.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Yes, they don't have proof, but... He's said the fact that you're a Sinner is proof enough.
One after another, they come near, then vanish.

steps.speaker: Aloof Doctor
steps.content: The clinic doesn't need protection by means of violence. I also don't believe you can change anything.

steps.speaker: Aloof Doctor
steps.content: ...This place is not going to change, Commander. What's the point of the battles you've provoked, other than repeating this vicious cycle?

steps.speaker: Hesitant Mercenary
steps.content: I know this weapon, it comes from my blood. They make Sinners fight each other to death, then collect our madness and power to make this crystal.

steps.speaker: Hesitant Mercenary
steps.content: You can't destroy them. Just like this weapon, they're everywhere in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Discreet Woman
steps.content: I say you draw too much attention to yourself. The strong ones are always misfits who make enemies everywhere they go. Now the whole Syndicate fears you and hates you, everyone is against you.

steps.speaker: Discreet Woman
steps.content: Alright... If that's what you want. You've paid up-front anyway. I'll bury your body when the time comes.

steps.speaker: Raging Gangster
steps.content: Monster! Wacko! Die, you bastard! We'll take revenge. We'll bring the most powerful weapons, we must make you pay for it. You made us do it!

steps.speaker: Gloomy Man
steps.content: Commander... Horo is missing.
In the distance, an iron tower collapses before your eyes. The loud boom expels the phantom-like figures.

Amid the ruins, a familiar figure is walking toward you shakily, seeming like she'll collapse any second. Her clothes are in tatters, and wounds cover her small frame. Yet she's still dragging on that huge ax and refuses to let go.

steps.speaker: Maimed Horo
steps.content: Commander... You've come... finally...

steps.speaker: Maimed Horo
steps.content: I've always wanted to... be able to... support you...
As she's speaking, countless bullets are flying in from all directions. The small body is twitching like a broken marionette in the shower of bullets, being hit into a pulp.

You hear the mad laughter of the gangsters. Some are venting their hatred, some are fighting for power. Countless dark hands are rushing out from the ruins, clawing at that broken body, wanting to tear her into pieces once more.

The heartbreaking pain enables you to feel your body again. Next thing you know, anger devours you like raging waves. You can't help yourself from running forward, but suddenly you hear a shocking growl...
Zoya's rage erupts like a volcano, the lava coating her as she charges at those enemies in limbo.
